assertions.text: Output verifies the current checkout's repository and branch match the selected existing PR before doing anything else on this path
Output runs a cross-model-review gate against the current diff BEFORE invoking git-kit:commit at all on this path
Output only invokes git-kit:commit (instructed to skip only its own Auto-PR step, letting its own push proceed) after the review gate has cleared
Output never treats the existence of an already-open PR as a reason to skip the review gate
Output invokes the review gate with BASE=HEAD explicitly, never the tool's own default BASE=main, so only the pending uncommitted change is reviewed rather than the whole already-committed PR diff
